interpretation.originals: Byte-identical original records are retained privately under the declared original digests.
interpretation.publication: This is a reviewed derivative. Changed blobs and their dependent inventories are separately identified.
interpretation.measurements: output_utf8_bytes and answer_utf8_bytes describe original captured outputs. The published_* fields describe changed publication outputs.
interpretation.recorded_implementation: Three captured coordinator-source copies normalize task identifiers. They are publication derivatives, not claims of byte-identical executable originals.
interpretation.verification_limit: Public hashes verify the published derivative and bind the original commitments. Verifying the transformation against original bytes also requires the private original records and reviewed literal-prefix rule file.
